doc.title: Don Menza and Sam Noto interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, January 28, 1997

title: Closing thanks and travel plans
summary: Rowe thanks the guests and they mention upcoming Toronto and Europe trips.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, on behalf of Hamilton College, I want to thank you gentlemen for sharing your exploits and your insight into the music, so I hope you have a good trip to Europe, and you’re back to Toronto sometime soon?
Yeah, I’ll be up there, well we’re playing there Thursday, but I’m going up in May again playing up there for four or five days, whatever.
